sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1992
ACT VII OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 13th December, 1992]
No. PAB/LEGIS.III(5)/92, dated
13-12-1992.--The Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Bill, 1992
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 24th November,
1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 26th day of August, 1990.

Amendment of section 3 of Ordinance XXXI of 1960

ACT VII OF 1992
ACT VII OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 13th December, 1992]
No. PAB/LEGIS.III(5)/92, dated
13-12-1992.--The Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Bill, 1992
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 24th November,
1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
2. Amendment of section 3 of Ordinance XXXI of 1960.--In the
Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960, for subsection (5) of
section 3, the following shall be substituted:--
"(5)
Government shall constitute a Board consisting of a Chairman and two other
persons, each of whom is or has been a Judge of a High Court, who shall be
appointed by the Chief Justice of the High Court of Balochistan".
